acceptanceCriteria: The report page states plainly that these are GROSS supply-risk figures — recycling (EoL_RIR) and substitution (SI_SR) filters are out of scope per DEC-001 — so they are not misread as official EU CRM SR values.

A before/after comparison for at least 5 materials is recorded in the task notes: plain HHI ranking versus governance- and trade-weighted ranking.
The comparison explicitly states whether the weighting changed the ranking. A null result — weighting barely moves the order — is a valid and reportable outcome, not a failure.
